summary: Critical Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K providing historical financial statements and pro forma information for two previously disclosed acquisitions: (1) the April 29, 2026 acquisition of a 50.5% interest in Tanbreez Mining Greenland A/S, increasing ownership to 92.5% (Tanbreez Transaction), and (2) the binding May 18, 2026 Scheme Implementation Deed to acquire all shares and listed options of European Lithium Ltd. via two interdependent Australian schemes of arrangement (EUR Transaction). The EUR Transaction is conditional on European Lithium shareholder approval and expected to close in H2 2026. No deal price, premium, or advisor is disclosed in this filing. The filing is purely procedural to comply with Regulation S-X. Watch for shareholder vote timing and regulatory clearance for the EUR Transaction.
